title: INDUS-DEDUCT: A Calibrated, Anti-Hallucination Computational Benchmark for the Indus Valley Script
description: An end-to-end, reproducible 13-layer computational epigraphy benchmark across 5,679 Indus Valley (Harappan) inscriptions (5,805 parsed lines; 713 raw signs). Features five-way matched known-answer and non-linguistic calibration (Indus vs. Ur III Sumerian CDLI, Linear B, Linear A, and structured non-linguistic stamps), exact 23-seal Max-CSP identifiability boundaries, Mohenjo-daro Copper Tablet (TAB:C) internal Rosetta and H1 refutation, Harappa double-sided token locks, Lothal multi-signature cargo network, Export Header #091 audit, 700-year de-confounded paleographic drift chains (#156->#154 and #838->#803->#806, replicated across Mohenjo-daro and Harappa), and a 690-inscription strict Leave-One-City-Out (LOCO) damaged restoration catalog. Zero fabricated phonetic readings; 11/11 machine-verified claim-ledger invariants.
